summary: Iteration 6 backend (Job Bank live scraper) is rock solid — 5/5 pytest tests pass. CRITICAL frontend bug: <LiveJobs/> is imported in JobsPage.jsx but never rendered, so the entire live-jobs-section / refresh button / live-job-* cards are completely absent from /jobs.

ui_bugs.issue: LiveJobs component is imported (line 6) but never rendered. The page contains <JobFeeds/> and the spotlight section, but no <LiveJobs/>. As a result data-testid='live-jobs-section', 'live-jobs-refresh', and 'live-job-*' cards are NOT in the DOM. Verified via Playwright on https://youth-worx-connect.preview.emergentagent.com/jobs.

Even when LiveJobs is rendered, the spec requires it to appear BEFORE <JobFeeds/>. Current import order suggests author intent matched spec, but render call is missing entirely. Add <LiveJobs/> immediately above <JobFeeds/> at line 61.

action_items: Add <LiveJobs /> JSX to /app/frontend/src/pages/JobsPage.jsx immediately above the existing <JobFeeds /> at line 61 (the import on line 6 already exists).

After fix, retest: visit /jobs, confirm live-jobs-section is present, contains live-job-* cards linking to https://www.jobbank.gc.ca/jobsearch/jobposting/..., refresh button spins, and audience switch (Youth ↔ Newcomers) re-fetches /api/live-jobs with different fyt=1 query.
critical_code_review_comments: JobsPage.jsx imports LiveJobs but never uses it — likely a missed paste during the iteration. Trivial 1-line fix.

jobbank_scraper.py: cache key currently uses audience only; if upstream HTML structure changes, caller still gets serialized stale data — acceptable given fallback behaviour, but log a warning when serving stale on parse failure (already implemented, good).
server.py /api/live-jobs maps audience='immigrant' -> fetch_aud='all'. Spec says newcomers benefit from broader feed; this is intentional and documented inline. OK.
LiveJobs.jsx: data-testid uses raw j.id which can contain special chars from Job Bank article ids (e.g. '43234567'); current ids are numeric so selector ^='live-job-' works. Fine.
CORS allow_origin_regex matches *.preview.emergentagent.com — correct for the active REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

success_rate.frontend: 0% — live-jobs feature entirely missing from rendered DOM

test_credentials: n/a (live-jobs is public, no auth required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/live-jobs verified end-to-end: real HRM jobs returned (Halifax/Dartmouth/Bedford/Sackville/etc.), all locations contain '(NS)' + HRM community, no Antigonish/Sydney/Truro etc., apply_url starts with https://www.jobbank.gc.ca/jobsearch/jobposting/, source='Job Bank Canada', audience=youth applies fyt=1 and second call returns cached:true within TTL, limit=5 caps results. Cache TTL 30 min in-memory — avoid hammering. Frontend bug is 1-line fix in JobsPage.jsx; once added, simply re-verify the four UI bullets in the request.
rca of the issue: JobsPage.jsx contains `import LiveJobs from '../components/LiveJobs';` on line 6 but the JSX tree (lines 27-104) only renders <JobFeeds /> on line 61 — the developer forgot to add the matching <LiveJobs /> JSX. Reproduction: open /jobs, run document.querySelector("[data-testid='live-jobs-section']") in console -> null. Mitigation: insert `<LiveJobs />` on a new line directly before `<JobFeeds />` at line 61.
